verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a programmatic offer search that an agent can run before renting anything. The CLI's `vastai search offers` supports filters such as `rentable=true` and `verified=true` and can sort by price-performance (`dlperf_usd`); the SDK exposes `search_offers`; both sit on a documented REST API with a live OpenAPI spec. Docs also describe a marketplace where hosts set prices that the search exposes, and an official agent skill lets AI assistants drive the platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the per-hour price and availability fields returned by offer search, clarity on whether catalog queries need an API key (i.e. truly public access), and independent hands-on confirmation that API-listed prices and availability match what is actually rentable.
